summary: Zoomcar Holdings, Inc. filed Form 8-K under Item 8.01 on October 8, 2026, disclosing an extension of the offering termination date under its previously launched bridge financing. With the agreement of the Placement Agent, the scheduled termination date under the Securities Purchase Agreements with investors was pushed from October 9, 2026 to November 16, 2026, and may be further extended. No pricing, stake, or structural terms were provided in this excerpt. The filing is a routine administrative update to an existing capital raise, not a new special situation; watch for closing progress and liquidity conditions.
